armyRules.name: Martial Ka'tah
armyRules.effect: When a unit is selected to fight, choose one Ka'tah Stance until it finishes making attacks: Dacatarai Stance (melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]) or Rendax Stance (melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS]).

battleFormations.name: Talons Of The Emperor
battleFormations.effect: Revered Companions: ANATHEMA PSYKANA units gain Null Aegis (Aura 6": Feel No Pain 5+ vs Psychic Attacks/mortal wounds for nearby CUSTODES); other CUSTODES gain Deadly Unity (Aura 6": +1 to Hit for nearby ANATHEMA PSYKANA attacks).

battleFormations.name: Shield Host
battleFormations.effect: Martial Mastery: At the start of the battle round, select until the next battle round: an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit for Ka'tah models, OR Ka'tah models gain +1 AP in melee.

battleFormations.name: Null Maiden Vigil
battleFormations.effect: Creeping Dread (Aura): Enemy PSYKER or below-starting-strength units within 12" of ANATHEMA PSYKANA models must take a Battle-shock test in their own Command phase (-1 if Below Half-strength). PROSECUTORS gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

battleFormations.name: Auric Champions
battleFormations.effect: Assemblage of Might: Select an enemy unit each Command phase; CUSTODES CHARACTER attacks against it gain +1 to the Wound roll.

battleFormations.name: Solar Spearhead
battleFormations.effect: Auric Armour + Moritoi Ancients: Full-strength non-Battle-shocked, non-AIRCRAFT VEHICLE units get +2 OC; below-strength re-roll Hit rolls of 1; below-half re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. WALKER units get +2" Move and +1 to Advance/Charge rolls. Up to 2 WALKER models can gain the CHARACTER keyword.

artefacts.name: Aegis Projector
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Once per turn, the first failed save against the bearer this turn instead inflicts Damage 0.

artefacts.name: Champion of the Imperium
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] The bearer's aura abilities have their range increased to 9".

artefacts.name: Gift of Terran Artifice
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Add 1 to the Wound roll for melee attacks made by the bearer.

artefacts.name: Radiant Mantle
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Attackers within 12" of the bearer suffer -1 to Hit rolls against the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Auric Mantle
artefacts.effect: [SHIELD-CAPTAIN/BLADE CHAMPION only] Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

artefacts.name: Castellan's Mark
artefacts.effect: [SHIELD-CAPTAIN only] Redeploy up to 2 units (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA), any of which can instead be placed into Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: From the Hall of Armouries
artefacts.effect: [SHIELD-CAPTAIN only] Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

artefacts.name: Panoptispex
artefacts.effect: [SHIELD-CAPTAIN/BLADE CHAMPION only] Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer's led unit gain the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

artefacts.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
artefacts.effect: [ANATHEMA PSYKANA only] Subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of attacks that target the bearer (to a minimum of 1), worsened further vs PSYKER or Battle-shocked attackers.

artefacts.name: Huntress' Eye
artefacts.effect: [ANATHEMA PSYKANA only] In your Command phase, force a nearby enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test.

artefacts.name: Oblivion Knight
artefacts.effect: [ANATHEMA PSYKANA only] The bearer's led unit gains +1 to Hit rolls; +1 to Wound rolls against PSYKER units.

artefacts.name: Raptor Blade
artefacts.effect: [ANATHEMA PSYKANA only] Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength, and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons (add 2 instead vs Battle-shocked PSYKER units in range).

artefacts.name: Blade Imperator
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Charge-move mortal wound trigger; once per battle, a Battle-shock pulse ability.

artefacts.name: Inspirational Exemplar
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] The bearer has a Leadership characteristic of 5+; can clear Battle-shock from a nearby unit once per battle.

artefacts.name: Martial Philosopher
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Eligible to shoot and charge after Falling Back; once per battle a reactive move ability.

artefacts.name: Veiled Blade
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Add 2 to the bearer's Attacks characteristic in melee; once per battle triple the bearer's Objective Control.

artefacts.name: Adamantine Talisman
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength, and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

artefacts.name: Augury Uplink
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES only] The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

artefacts.name: Honoured Fallen
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE only] Aura: nearby friendly Infantry/Mounted units re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

artefacts.name: Veteran of the Kataphraktoi
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED only] Grants a nearby friendly Vehicle/Mounted unit the ability to shoot after Falling Back.

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation.
